findings.claim: 10-K 稱 Blackstone 業務已從機構投資人擴及透過多種通路銷售給高淨值與大眾富裕個人的產品；私人財富通路占總 AUM 比重逐年上升，預期延續，並在拓展 401(k)等 DC 通路。
findings.excerpt: In recent years, capital from the private wealth channel has represented an increasing portion of our Total Assets Under Management, and we expect this trend to continue as we continue to undertake initiatives focused on this market segment.

findings.claim: 10-K 指出私人財富與保險通路競爭激烈，部分競爭者願收較低費用或付較高分銷費。
findings.excerpt: In addition, competition for fundraising in the private wealth and insurance channels is also driven by the willingness of certain of our competitors to charge lower fees or pay higher or different types of distributors fees.

findings.claim: 私人財富通路 AUM 於 2026-06-30 達 $324B（2026-03-31 為 $310B）；Q2 2026 私人財富 AUM 年增 16%，BXPE NAV 逾 $25B。
findings.source: Blackstone BXINFRA 基金頁；Nasdaq「Blackstone Q2 earnings call highlights」
findings.excerpt: Blackstone's private wealth AUM grew 16% year-over-year to a record $324 billion.

findings.claim: Blackstone 於 2026-01-14 加入 Empower 私募市場夥伴計畫，經集合投資信託(CIT)與顧問管理帳戶切入 401(k)；2025-10 已成立專屬退休解決方案部門。
findings.source: Alternative Credit Investor「Blackstone partners with Empower in 401(k) push」
